simple.prompt: I really enjoy ___ international podcasts during my morning commute.
simple.explanation: Kata kerja enjoy selalu diikuti oleh Gerund (verb-ing): enjoy listening to.

simple.prompt: We decided ___ the product launch until next quarter.
simple.explanation: Kata kerja decide selalu diikuti oleh to-infinitive: decided to postpone.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan gerund sebagai subjek kalimat.
simple.targetSentence: Learning foreign languages opens new career opportunities.
simple.explanation: Gerund (Learning) bertindak sebagai subjek kalimat tunggal.
hints: Awali dengan gerund subjek Learning foreign languages.
Main verb adalah opens new career opportunities.

simple.prompt: She promised ___ the finalized quarterly forecast by Friday afternoon.
simple.explanation: Promise diikuti oleh to-infinitive: promised to send.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan kata kerja avoid + gerund.
simple.targetSentence: Drivers should avoid using mobile phones while driving.
simple.explanation: Avoid selalu diikuti gerund: avoid using.

simple.prompt: The company hopes ___ its operations to European markets next year.
simple.explanation: Hope berpasangan dengan to-infinitive: hopes to expand.

simple.targetSentence: The suspect refused to answer any questions.
simple.explanation: Refuse berpasangan dengan to-infinitive: refused to answer.
hints: Verb dasar adalah answer any questions.

simple.prompt: Our team enjoys ___ coffee together after finishing weekly demos.
simple.explanation: Kata kerja 'enjoy' selalu diikuti oleh gerund (V-ing), tidak pernah memakai to-infinitive.

simple.prompt: She decided ___ the remote engineering role in Singapore.
simple.explanation: Kata kerja rencana/keputusan seperti 'decide', 'hope', dan 'plan' diikuti to-infinitive ('to accept').

simple.prompt: ___ daily vocabularies in context makes retention much stronger.
simple.explanation: Ketika kata kerja menjadi subjek di awal kalimat, gunakan bentuk gerund ('Reviewing...').
hints: Fungsinya adalah subjek kalimat untuk verb 'makes'.
Kata kerja sebagai subjek memakai V-ing (gerund).

simple.prompt: Thank you for ___ our presentation slides before noon.
simple.explanation: Setelah preposisi apa pun ('for', 'in', 'about', 'without'), kata kerja WAJIB berbentuk gerund (V-ing): 'updating'.
hints: Ada kata depan 'for' tepat di depan rumpang.

dialogue: Lead
Why hasn't Toby sent the invoice yet?
Assistant
He keeps ___ the client because he worries about the pricing dispute.

simple.prompt: We promised ___ the final tax receipts by Friday afternoon.
simple.explanation: Verb 'promise' diikuti oleh to-infinitive ('promise to send').

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda infinitive setelah 'suggest' pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: The operations coordinator suggested to move the briefing to Wednesday morning.
options: The operations coordinator suggested moving the briefing to Wednesday morning.
The operations coordinator suggested to moving the briefing to Wednesday morning.
The operations coordinator suggested move the briefing to Wednesday morning.
simple.explanation: 'Suggest' TIDAK boleh langsung diikuti 'to + V1'; gunakan gerund ('suggested moving').

simple.prompt: Are you interested in ___ the bilingual mentorship program?
simple.explanation: Frasa kata sifat berpreposisi 'interested in' wajib diikuti gerund ('joining').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai to-infinitive setelah verb 'agree'.
simple.targetSentence: Both parties agreed to extend the service contract for one year.
hints: Awali dengan 'Both parties agreed to extend'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat yang menempatkan gerund phrase sebagai subjek.
simple.targetSentence: Writing concise emails saves busy managers valuable time.
simple.explanation: Frasa gerund 'Writing concise emails' bertindak sebagai subjek tunggal bagi 'saves'.
hints: Mulai dengan subjek gerund 'Writing concise emails'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perubahan makna pada kata kerja remember.
dialogue: Parent
Did you lock the front door?
Son
Yes, I distinctly remember ___ it before leaving the house.
intermediate.explanation: Remember + gerund (-ing) berarti mengingat kembali aksi yang SUDAH dilakukan di masa lalu. Sebaliknya remember to lock berarti ingat untuk melakukan kewajiban.
hints: Mengingat kenangan aksi yang sudah dilakukan sebelumnya.

intermediate.prompt: Please remember ___ the front door before you leave for the airport tonight.
intermediate.explanation: Remember + to-infinitive berarti jangan lupa untuk melakukan suatu tugas/kewajiban di masa depan.
hints: Perintah/pengingat untuk jangan lupa melakukan tugas.

intermediate.prompt: The presentation was getting monotonous, so the speaker stopped ___ a sip of water.
intermediate.explanation: Stop + to-infinitive berarti berhenti sejenak dari suatu aktivitas DENGAN TUJUAN untuk melakukan hal lain. Stop taking berarti menghentikan kebiasaan minum.
hints: Berhenti sejenak demi tujuan tertentu (in order to).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan look forward to + gerund.
intermediate.targetSentence: We look forward to collaborating with your team.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam frasa look forward to, kata to adalah PREPOSISI, sehingga wajib diikuti Gerund (-ing): collaborating.
hints: To di sini adalah preposisi, bukan to-infinitive.

intermediate.prompt: I will never forget ___ the Northern Lights in Iceland for the very first time.
intermediate.explanation: Forget + gerund merujuk pada kenangan masa lalu yang tidak akan pernah terlupakan.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan kata kerja suggest + gerund.
intermediate.targetSentence: The doctor suggested getting more regular sleep.
hints: Gunakan gerund getting more regular sleep.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perubahan makna pada try.
dialogue: Friend
My head is throbbing with pain.
Doctor
Try ___ a glass of cold water and resting in a dark room.
intermediate.explanation: Try + gerund berarti melakukan eksperimen/mencoba suatu metode sebagai solusi untuk melihat apakah efektif. Try to do berarti mengerahkan tenaga/usaha keras.
hints: Mencoba suatu metode sebagai eksperimen solusi.

intermediate.prompt: Contrast meaning: 'Don't forget ___ the security alarm before locking up' (future task) vs 'I will never forget ___ our first client in Tokyo' (past memory).
intermediate.explanation: 'Forget + to V1' berarti lupa melaksanakan tugas mendatang; 'forget + V-ing' berarti melupakan kenangan peristiwa yang sudah dialami di masa lalu.
hints: Tugas yang belum dikerjakan memakai 'to V1'.

intermediate.prompt: On our drive back, we stopped ___ some fresh fruit at a roadside stall.
intermediate.explanation: 'Stop + to V1' berarti berhenti dari aktivitas sebelumnya (menyetir) AGAR dapat melakukan tindakan baru (membeli buah).
hints: Berhenti mengemudi dengan tujuan membeli buah.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang penolakan kebiasaan dengan 'stop + gerund'.
dialogue: Doctor
Has your uncle improved his sleep routine?
Niece
Yes, he completely stopped ___ coffee after five o'clock.
intermediate.explanation: 'Stop + V-ing' berarti menghentikan suatu aktivitas atau kebiasaan sepenuhnya ('berhenti minum kopi').
hints: Maknanya menghentikan kebiasaan minum kopi sore.

intermediate.prompt: I am really looking forward to ___ your team in person at the Jakarta expo.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam frasa idiomatik 'look forward to', kata 'to' adalah PREPOSISI (bukan bagian dari to-infinitive), sehingga WAJIB diikuti gerund ('meeting').
hints: Uji dengan mengganti kata kerja menjadi noun: 'looking forward to the expo'.
Karena 'to' di sini preposisi, ikuti dengan '-ing'.

intermediate.prompt: Your bicycle chain sounds squeaky; it clearly needs ___.
intermediate.explanation: Setelah kata kerja 'need', 'require', atau 'want' dengan subjek benda mati, bentuk V-ing ('needs oiling') memiliki makna PASIF ('perlu diminyaki', setara 'needs to be oiled').
hints: Rantai sepeda tidak meminyaki dirinya sendiri.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyambung 'used to' (terbiasa) dengan infinitive berikut.
intermediate.draft: It took two months, but now our night crew is used to work the automated shift.
options: It took two months, but now our night crew is used to working the automated shift.
It took two months, but now our night crew used to working the automated shift.
It took two months, but now our night crew is used to worked the automated shift.
intermediate.explanation: Konstruksi 'be used to' (= terbiasa) memakai 'to' sebagai preposisi, sehingga wajib diikuti gerund ('is used to working').
hints: 'Be used to + V-ing' berarti sudah terbiasa.

intermediate.prompt: Remember ___ the confirmation code before you close the browser tab!
intermediate.explanation: 'Remember + to V1' bermakna jangan lupa melakukan tugas yang akan datang; berbeda dengan 'remember + V-ing' (mengingat kejadian lampau).
hints: Aksi menyalin kode belum dilakukan dan menjadi pengingat.
Tugas pengingat ke depan memakai 'remember + to V1'.

intermediate.prompt: We tried ___ the modem by unplugging the power cable for thirty seconds, and it worked!
intermediate.explanation: 'Try + V-ing' berarti bereksperimen/mencoba suatu metode solusi untuk melihat apakah berhasil; sedangkan 'try + to V1' berarti berusaha keras melakukan hal yang sulit.
hints: Mereka mencoba satu cara eksperimen troubleshooting.
Mencoba suatu metode solusi memakai 'try + V-ing'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat memakai ungkapan idiomatik 'It's no use + gerund'.
intermediate.targetSentence: It's no use arguing about yesterday's shipping mistake now.
intermediate.explanation: Ungkapan tetap 'It's no use + V-ing' berarti 'percuma/tidak ada gunanya melakukan...'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan kata benda + 'need + V-ing' bermakna pasif.
intermediate.targetSentence: Several cracked office windows urgently need replacing before the monsoon.
intermediate.explanation: Subjek benda ('windows') + 'need replacing' (= need to be replaced).
hints: Mulai dengan 'Several cracked office windows urgently'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum setelah frasa preposisi be used to.
complex.draft: The new flight attendants are used to work long shifts across time zones.
options: The new flight attendants are used to working long shifts across time zones.
The new flight attendants used to working long shifts across time zones.
The new flight attendants are used to be working long shifts across time zones.
complex.explanation: Be used to berarti terbiasa dengan suatu kondisi. Huruf to di sini adalah preposisi, sehingga WAJIB diikuti Gerund (-ing): are used to working.
hints: Be used to (terbiasa) diikuti oleh gerund (-ing).

complex.prompt: We regret ___ you that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.
complex.explanation: Regret + to-infinitive adalah formula formal untuk menyampaikan kabar buruk dengan penuh sesal. Regret + gerund menyatakan penyesalan atas aksi masa lalu.
hints: Gunakan formula regret to inform you.

complex.prompt: The historic building is in terrible disrepair; the roof needs ___ before winter arrives.
complex.explanation: Struktur pasif unik: need + gerund (atau need to be repaired) bermakna pasif: atap tersebut perlu diperbaiki.
hints: Need + gerund memiliki makna pasif (needs repairing = needs to be repaired).

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan possessive case sebelum gerund (formal style).
complex.targetSentence: The board appreciated his taking the initiative.
complex.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris formal baku, kata benda atau pronoun sebelum gerund menggunakan bentuk possessive: his taking the initiative (bukan him taking).
hints: Gunakan possessive pronoun his sebelum gerund taking.
Formal style mensyaratkan possessive sebelum gerund.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan gerund setelah frasa it is no use.
complex.draft: It is no use to complain about circumstances beyond our direct control.
options: It is no use complaining about circumstances beyond our direct control.
It is no use complain about circumstances beyond our direct control.
It is no use of complaining about circumstances beyond our direct control.
complex.explanation: Idiom It is no use / It is no good selalu berpasangan dengan Gerund (-ing): It is no use complaining.
hints: Idiom It is no use diikuti oleh gerund.

complex.prompt: He is accused of financial fraud, but he denies ___ any unauthorized transactions.
complex.explanation: Deny diikuti oleh gerund. Untuk menekankan bahwa peristiwa terjadi sebelumnya, gunakan Perfect Gerund: denies having authorized.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi dengan frasa object to + gerund.
dialogue: Union Rep
Do the staff members agree to the new roster?
Manager
Several senior nurses object to ___ weekend shifts without overtime premiums.
complex.explanation: Object to adalah phrasal verb di mana to adalah preposisi, sehingga wajib diikuti Gerund: object to working.
hints: Object to (keberatan terhadap) diikuti oleh gerund (-ing).

complex.prompt: She strongly objected to ___ excluded from the final budget consultation.
complex.explanation: 'Object to' memakai preposisi 'to' dan maknanya pasif ('dikeluarkan/disisihkan'), sehingga membutuhkan Passive Gerund: 'being + V3 (being excluded)'.
hints: Setelah preposisi 'to' pada 'object to' harus memakai bentuk '-ing'.

complex.prompt: The chief auditor praised ___ flagging the duplicate invoice before payment cleared.
complex.explanation: Dalam ragam tulis formal dan tes tata bahasa presisi, subjek pelaku di depan gerund ('flagging...') memakai Possessive Determiner ('his flagging' / 'Riko's flagging').
hints: Perhatikan gerund 'flagging' sebagai objek dari verb 'praised'.
Gaya baku formal memakai possessive ('his') sebelum gerund.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk Perfect Gerund pada kalimat pengakuan lampau berikut.
complex.draft: The witness admitted to have seen the delivery van leave the alley at midnight.
options: The witness admitted having seen the delivery van leave the alley at midnight.
The witness admitted to had seen the delivery van leave the alley at midnight.
The witness admitted having saw the delivery van leave the alley at midnight.
complex.explanation: 'Admit (to)' dalam makna mengakui sesuatu di masa lalu diikuti gerund atau perfect gerund 'having seen' (atau 'to having seen'), BUKAN to-infinitive 'to have seen'.
hints: Verb 'admit' diikuti gerund (-ing), bukan 'to have V3'.
Untuk aksi lebih lampau, gunakan Perfect Gerund 'having seen'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang nuansa 'regret + to V1' vs 'regret + V-ing'.
dialogue: Dean
How should I open a formal scholarship rejection letter?
Advisor
Use the polite formula: 'We regret ___ you that your application was unsuccessful.'
complex.explanation: 'Regret + to inform / to say / to announce' adalah rumus resmi untuk menyampaikan kabar kurang menyenangkan saat ini ('dengan berat hati kami sampaikan...').
hints: Menyampaikan kabar buruk dalam surat resmi memakai 'regret + to V1'.

complex.prompt: He seems ___ his quarterly targets effortlessly, judging by today's dashboard.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'seem', ketika merujuk pada pencapaian yang telah terjadi SEBELUM sekarang, gunakan Perfect Infinitive: 'seems to have + V3 (to have exceeded)'.
hints: Menunjukkan hasil lampau yang tampak kesannya sekarang.

complex.prompt: Spending three hours formatting footnotes is not worth ___ if the journal accepts plain Markdown.
complex.explanation: Adjective idiomatik 'worth' WAJIB diikuti gerund aktif ('worth doing', 'worth reading'), TIDAK PERNAH 'worth to do' atau 'worth to be done'.
hints: 'Be worth' selalu berpasangan dengan V-ing aktif.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan penggunaan 'mean' dalam dua konteks berbeda berikut.
complex.draft: Hiring another senior developer will mean to increase our monthly payroll significantly.
options: Hiring another senior developer will mean increasing our monthly payroll significantly.
Hiring another senior developer will mean increase our monthly payroll significantly.
To hire another senior developer will mean to increasing our monthly payroll significantly.
complex.explanation: 'Mean + V-ing' bermakna 'berarti / berkonsekuensi mengakibatkan...', sedangkan 'mean + to V1' bermakna 'berniat'. Dalam konteks akibat keuangan di sini, wajib memakai gerund 'mean increasing'.
hints: Apakah mempekerjakan pengembang 'berniat' atau 'berkonsekuensi menyebabkan' kenaikan gaji?

complex.prompt: Notice the meaning shift in 'I meant ___ you earlier, but my battery died' (unfulfilled intention).
complex.explanation: Sebaliknya, ketika 'mean' menyatakan NIAT yang hendak dilakukan ('berniat meneleponmu tadi'), gunakan to-infinitive: 'meant to call'.
hints: Konteksnya niat yang gagal terlaksana karena baterai habis.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai Perfect Gerund sebagai penekanan aksi terdahulu.
complex.targetSentence: She took pride in having mentored twelve junior analysts to promotion.
complex.explanation: Setelah preposisi 'in', Perfect Gerund 'having mentored' menekankan pencapaian lampau yang sudah tuntas.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan kata sifat 'busy' atau 'difficulty' + gerund (tanpa preposisi 'in').
complex.targetSentence: Our onboarding team had difficulty verifying several blurry passport scans.
complex.explanation: Pola baku 'have difficulty / trouble + V-ing' tidak memerlukan 'to' dan memakai gerund 'verifying'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Our onboarding team had difficulty'.
